fields.description:
**Related:** WAGR-470 (historical data migration scope — decision, blocking), WAGR-20 (production migration plan)

**Summary:** Emily (WagerTech) asked on the 2026-09-28 call whether Jumpr is ready to provide data import templates for the key objects already scoped: Sign Up, Referral, Secondary Referral, Player. Their backend data cleanup work has stalled and she wants to restart it urgently — templates are the blocker. She will send exact requirements to Kobi directly via Slack.

**Do:** Build import templates for the four objects above so WagerTech can populate and send back clean data for ingestion.

**Open questions (carry over from WAGR-470, still undecided):**

* Historical Sign-Ups — yes or no
* Historical redeposit and payout data — in scope or not
* US Deals and Deal Rep Assignments
* The 26 Deals with no Source
* Whether legacy Google Sheets keep getting data during the switch-over

Per Kobi (Slack, 2026-09-28): enough information exists to put templates together this week even without Emily's answers yet; if existing scope questions surface, they go in an alignment doc for Emily to review, target tomorrow.

**Sources:** Fathom call transcript 2026-09-28 (Emily/Taryn - Operator: Supported Markets); Slack thread, Taryn/Kobi, 2026-09-28.
